## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Uncertainty
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Uncertainty
//  - Uncertain geometry and estimation
//  - Measurements, calibration, and sampled ensembles

//==
// # Uncertainty
//
// Scalar values that carry uncertainty without losing their nominal reading:
// measurement uncertainty, confidence intervals, engineering tolerances, and
// fuzzy numbers. Standard uncertainties are one standard deviation (1-sigma)
// unless a coverage factor says otherwise. Uncertain geometry, state
// estimation, and error propagation follow in the sections below.

// A measured or estimated number with its standard (1-sigma) uncertainty,
// in the same implicit unit as the value.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Measurement_uncertainty)
type UncertainNumber
    implements IValue
{
    Value: Number;
    StandardUncertainty: Number;
}

// A runtime-united measurement: an amount, its standard uncertainty in the
// same unit, and the unit itself.
type UncertainQuantity
    implements IValue
{
    Amount: Number;
    StandardUncertainty: Number;
    Unit: UnitOfMeasure;
}

// An expanded uncertainty per the GUM convention: the reported half-width is
// CoverageFactor times StandardUncertainty (k = 2 gives roughly 95%
// coverage for a normal error model).
type ExpandedUncertainty
    implements IValue
{
    StandardUncertainty: Number;
    CoverageFactor: Number;
}

// An interval asserted to contain the true value with the stated confidence
// Level (e.g. 0.95). Lower does not exceed Upper.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Confidence_interval)
type ConfidenceInterval
    implements IValue
{
    Lower: Number;
    Upper: Number;
    Level: Probability;
}

// The alpha of a hypothesis test: the accepted probability of rejecting a
// true null hypothesis (e.g. 0.05).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Statistical_significance)
type SignificanceLevel
    implements IValue
{
    Alpha: Probability;
}

// An asymmetric engineering tolerance about a nominal value. The acceptable
// range is [Nominal - Minus, Nominal + Plus]; Plus and Minus are
// non-negative magnitudes.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engineering_tolerance)
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Floating-point comparison (this is an
// acceptance allowance, explicitly NOT the ComparisonTolerance epsilon record).
type Tolerance
    implements IValue
{
    Nominal: Number;
    Plus: Number;
    Minus: Number;
}

// One endpoint of a one-dimensional range: the endpoint value and whether
// the endpoint itself is included.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Interval_(mathematics))
type IntervalBound
    implements IValue
{
    Value: Number;
    Inclusive: Boolean;
}

//==
// # Fuzzy numbers
//
// Fuzzy membership functions over the real line: membership is 0 outside
// the support, 1 on the core, and ramps linearly between.

// A triangular fuzzy number: support [A, C] with full membership only at
// the peak B, where A <= B <= C.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fuzzy_number)
type TriangularFuzzyNumber
    implements IValue
{
    A: Number;
    B: Number;
    C: Number;
}

// A trapezoidal fuzzy number: support [A, D] with full membership on the
// core [B, C], where A <= B <= C <= D.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Membership_function_(mathematics))
type TrapezoidalFuzzyNumber
    implements IValue
{
    A: Number;
    B: Number;
    C: Number;
    D: Number;
}

//==
// # Uncertain geometry and estimation
//
// Geometric values carrying Gaussian uncertainty as a covariance, the state
// and model records of a linear Kalman filter, and the choice of how
// uncertainty is carried through a computation. Covariance orders match the
// value they describe; the scalar uncertainty types are the section above.

//==
// # Uncertain geometry

// A 2D vector with a 2x2 covariance of its components.
type UncertainVector2D
    implements IValue
{
    Value: Vector2D;
    Covariance: Covariance2D;
}

// A 3D vector with a 3x3 covariance of its components.
type UncertainVector3D
    implements IValue
{
    Value: Vector3D;
    Covariance: Covariance3D;
}

// A 2D position with a 2x2 covariance of its coordinates.
type UncertainPoint2D
    implements IValue
{
    Value: Point2D;
    Covariance: Covariance2D;
}
```
